source: cms/governance-records.json (eligibility only) + private signed approvals file outside the document root
displayRule: Only after documented content-owner submission, appropriate reviewer sign-off and approver authorisation. All other states invisible.

reviewedBy.suggestedValue: Woolloongabba Medical Centre Clinical Team (only when they actually reviewed it)

lastReviewed.meaning: Actual clinical or governance content review date, not website update date

nextReview.meaning: Genuine approved next review due date (shown as Next Review Due); no automatic interval or inferred date.

contentOwner.meaning: Actual accountable department, agreed by practice management

approvalEvidence.approvalReference: Required internal unique approval or meeting/document ID
approvalEvidence.evidenceReference: Required record location in restricted-access internal storage
approvalEvidence.storage: Restricted-access file outside the website. Never deploy approvalReference, evidenceReference, approvedBy, approvedAt or fingerprint.
approvalEvidence.contentOwnerSubmittedBy: Required accountable staff identity, in private approvals only
approvalEvidence.reviewerSignedAt: Real sign-off date; must equal Last Reviewed
approvalEvidence.reviewType: Must match page eligibility clinical, operational or institutional

approvalsCanBeImported: After documented sign-off, run cms/tools/build_clinical_governance.py --approvals /secure/path/approvals.json --build. Never store approvals inside the public web root.
expirySafety: The builder rejects expired approval records and the browser suppresses stale dates after Next Review Due; an expired review cannot remain marked currently approved.
scopeValidation: cms/tools/check_governance_framework.py --check validates all 102 Knowledge Centre pages, all 29 service pages, patient information and governance entries, with no public placeholders.
